title: #205 - A Conversation with Charlie Munger
summary: Ross School of Business, had the chance to sit down with Munger at an event in Los Angeles. The two discussed Munger’s life, career, and global trends. Munger, with his characteristic straightforward wisdom, did not mince words on some of the biggest issues facing the country including bitcoin and cryptocurrency, political fights in congress, and the state of the US democracy.

reader_summary.overview: Charlie Munger is an American institution –– vice chair of Berkshire Hathaway, business partner to Warren Buffett, philanthropist, author, and former University of Michigan student. Recently, Scott DeRue, the Edward J. Ross School of Business, had the chance to sit down with Munger at an event in Los Angeles.
